input: Schedule a property valuation before listing

gold.taskTitle: Schedule a Property Valuation Before Listing
gold.taskDescription: Arrange a professional property valuation in preparation for listing the property on the market.

questions.title: What type of property are you valuing?
questions.description: Identify whether the property is residential, commercial, apartment, land, etc.

questions.title: What is the full address of the property?
questions.description: Capture the exact location of the property to be valued.

questions.title: Do you already have a valuator or agent in mind?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has a preferred professional or needs help finding one.

questions.title: What is your target date for listing the property?
questions.description: Establish the listing deadline to work backwards and set a valuation appointment in time.

questions.title: Is this valuation for selling, refinancing, or insurance?
questions.description: Clarify the purpose of the valuation as it affects the type of report needed.

questions.title: Are there recent renovations the valuator should know about?
questions.description: Identify any upgrades or changes to the property that could affect its assessed value.

questions.title: Do you need a formal written report or a verbal estimate?
questions.description: Determine the format of the valuation output required for the user's purposes.
